archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Dark Mode Variant - Command Center)
design_philosophy: Functional over flashy. High information density, analyst-focused. Objective, rigid, functional. Color is used for function only (e.g., severity flags, KEV chips). 95% of the UI is monochrome dark to reduce eye strain during long operations. No generic purple/teal gradients. Command center feel similar to Splunk/Datadog/DefectDojo.

rules.anti_default: Strictly avoid Inter, Roboto, Open Sans.
rules.hierarchy: Maximum text size is text-2xl or text-3xl for dashboards. No massive text.
rules.monospace_usage: Must use JetBrains Mono for CVSS scores, IPs, hashes, KEV IDs, and dense table data.

spacing_and_layout.density: High density. Tables should fit 10-20+ rows without scrolling. Use py-1.5 px-3 for table cells instead of default padding.
spacing_and_layout.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. border-collapse style layout for tables and dense lists. Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle borders (border-border), no shadows.

components.tables: Dense, filterable. Sticky headers. Use Shadcn Table but customize for high density. Implement sorting and multi-select. py-1.5 px-3 cells.
components.badges: Use subtle background/border approach for Severity, KEV, EPSS, RTI chips. Must not be loud blocks of color.
components.buttons: Compact (h-7 or h-8). Solid for primary (e.g., Run Scan), outline/ghost for actions (e.g., Export).
components.sidebar: Grouped nav: Operations, Inventory, Integrations, Admin. Use Phosphor Icons. High contrast active state.
components.charts: Recharts. Use area charts and bar charts. Avoid pie charts if possible, prefer progress bars or stacked bars for risk breakdowns. Must be color-blind friendly.
components.dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog. Must have a darkened backdrop (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm) to focus attention on the modal.

motion.animations: Minimalist. Hover states (bg-slate-800/50), focus states. No bounce or slide animations. Transitions must be fast (duration-150).

icons_and_assets.usage: Phosphor Icons for dense UI elements. React-icons (Simple Icons / si) for integration logos (Qualys, Nessus, CrowdStrike, Wiz, Jira, ServiceNow, GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps).
icons_and_assets.images: No stock photography required. UI relies entirely on typography, data, and charts.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case (e.g., `data-testid="export-csv-button"`).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast standards. Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g., `hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Write all components as .js files (not .tsx) using React 19.
Install required fonts: IBM Plex Sans and JetBrains Mono via CSS import in index.css (e.g., from Google Fonts).
Run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react react-icons` to install required icon sets.
Configure tailwind.config.js with the provided dark colors mapping to background, surface, and border.
Strip default Shadcn paddings in Table, Card, and Button components to achieve the required 'Command Center' density (e.g., h-8 buttons, py-1.5 table cells).
Build the Findings Workbench as a dense table showing Severity, CVSS, KEV chip, asset, owner, SLA countdown.
Build Executive Dashboards using Recharts for risk trends and SLA compliance.
Ensure the application enforces a strict Dark Theme. Do not implement a light theme.
Apply `data-testid` universally across all interactive elements for automated testing.
